cues: night over Paris: far city murmur, wind rising with the climb, antenna hum
rise up the wire: fast rising whoosh, wire singing
first ring born at the summit lamp: bright electric 'ping' flash
a soft pulse every 18 f as each ring is born and spreads over the city
whole lattice + wire glow blue-white on 'เสาอากาศยักษ์': swelling electric chime
SWOOP down the tower face: long falling whoosh, ground rumble coming up
iron bars shouldered: clink of crowbars, boots on gravel
'ไร้ประโยชน์': the men stop: hush
three crowbars DROP and clatter on the gravel (staggered 1 f apart)
officer salute: heel click + glove slap + a short bugle note
wagon and cart roll away to the right: creaking wheels, hooves, fading
snap push on 'ขาดไม่ได้': rising whoosh + a proud chord
dissolve (13 f) into T23, 1910 day fair
